text:
The assistant corrected some spelling and verb agreement errors (e.g., “remembre” to “remember,” “he’s say” to “he said,” “on kitchen table” to “on the kitchen table”), but failed to fix several grammatical issues: the indirect question word order (“where is her purse” should be “where her purse is”), tense consistency (“I thought it’s” should be “I thought it was”), nonstandard phrasing (“ain’t no sure” left uncorrected), and incorrect past tense forms (“didn’t heard” should be “didn’t hear,” “Did you found” should be “Did you find”). The edit is incomplete and still contains errors.

Rating: [[3]]
